profile.headline: Software Developer - Revenue Accounting at American Airlines
profile.summary:
Experience Summary:
I am a  IT professional with 20+ years of experience in a variety of positions that have given me a comprehensive understanding of the full System Development Lifecycle, from gathering business requirements to implementation. I have been successful as a Project Leader, Business Systems Analyst, Quality Assurance Leader and Programmer Analyst.

My technical expertise spans mainframe, AZURE, DATA BRICKS, utility industry, insurance, payroll, and accounting applications. I am proficient at data mapping, designing and creating new interface programs, and modifications to existing programs.

I have excellent problem solving and analytical skills with a proven ability to learn new systems, work independently, and make decisions which bring positive results.

My most recent experience (05/2015 to present) has been with RAC IT, developing, maintaining, on-call support, for the different applications in RAC IT.

I have good relationships with the business and can contribute/make recommendations as appropriate.

With all the roles I have had in my career, my favorite is development.

As Project Leader I exercised project management skills to develop and track detailed project plans. I have customer and vendor management experience in documenting requirements, developing audit reports and acting as the sole technical interface to a software vendor and lead analyst for ancillary IT support. My QA leadership experience includes developing integrated and independent test plans, planning and establishing test environments, creating test scripts to ensure the quality, accuracy and applicability of IT applications and software packages to the project requirements and business processes. I have lead End-to-End Quality Assurance and System Validation efforts spanning Mainframe, Oracle, web, and End User online, distributed and batch environments.

I have hands-on experience testing client/server, web and legacy applications and in validation using DB2 Spufi queries, Mainframe files, reports, Unix files, and Oracle tables to develop and validate test plans and detailed test data.

Technical Summary:	
COBOL/COBOL II, DB2, SQL, QMF, SPUFI, HTML, TSO, JCL, IBM/MVS (z/OS), MQ SERIES, XPEDITER, EASYTRIEVE, SAS, VSAM, FILEAID, IBM Utilities, SYNCSORT, FTP, AFP, CA Scheduler ,UNIX , ORACLE DB, SQL SERVER, , SCLM, PANVALET, LIBRARIAN, Microsoft Office (MS Access, MS Project, MS Word, MS Excel, MS PowerPoint)
PYTHON, DATA BRICKS, AZURE PIPELINES

positions.title: Software Developer - Revenue Accounting
positions.description:
Post US Airways/American Airlines merger, moved to new position with Revenue Accounting
AMERICAN AIRLINES , Tempe, AZ (05/2015 to present)
Senior Developer, designing, developing and maintaining applications to deliver benefits to the business.
I have worked on Usage, Interline, Sales, Payments and presently Refunds.
In Refunds we support stored procedures, DB2, multi environment testing, On-Call, working closely with Mainframe Operations.

positions.title: Senior Developer
positions.description: Architecting, developing new, and maintaining applications to deliver business benefits. Was able to contribute on multiple business domains, Ticket Sales data consumption and processing. Credit Card payments, Ticket Refunds and Interline Billing with other Airlines. Worked well with other Airline carrier billing to resolve any discrepancies. As a result of multi-domain knowledge was able to determine problems more quickly and work with the domains to come to a workable solution. Created test plans to ensure complete end to end processing as needed. Worked with our Mainframe Operations to schedule Jobs where they are needed. Documented Jobs in our Docutex form to give instructions in case of an issue with the Job. On-call duties, collaborating closely with Mainframe Operations based off shore.

positions.title: Mainframe Developer
positions.description: Developer in the Dividend Miles area

positions.title: Senior Programming Analyst
positions.description: Engineered batch DB2 programs to process Dividend Miles flown data for US Airways Frequent Flyer members. Executed major modifications to programs, tables, flight posting, member account updates, tier level movements/upgrades, and billing processes to integrate with the new Oneworld Alliance. Developed programs and processes for data migration and data auditing for the Single Frequent Flyer Program (SFFP), recognized as the world's largest Loyalty Experience program. Enhanced programs, tables, and processes within the Dividend Miles program to meet STAR Alliance requirements. Created new programs to support special promotions initiated by the Marketing department. Modeled new tables and designed a batch process for updating and reporting audit information related to inbound and outbound files exchanged with other airlines. Authored comprehensive test plans and scenarios for inter-airline testing and internal team validation. Provided on-call production support for the DB2-based Policy System, encompassing initial troubleshooting, problem resolution, and operational decision-making for this critical, large-scale system. Engaged in daily communication with Operations to implement production improvements and permanent fixes. Gained proficiency in using SYNCSORT, IBM Utilities, COBOL, DB2, and SQL through this experience.

positions.title: Senior Programming Analyst
positions.description: Operated within a COBOL DB2 Mainframe environment for SRP’s ‘Pre-Paid Meter (MPower)’ project. Developed technical specifications, wrote new programs, and implemented enhancements to existing programs in CICS and batch processing. Authored the String Test Strategy document and created string test cases. Led a team of programmers in executing string test cases, validating results across DB2 tables, reports, and online screens. The team developed 130 test scripts, identifying 45 defects. Served as a developer on a project to replace legacy processes in CICS and batch programs, integrating MQ Series for data transport between applications. Developed programs to generate electronic letters for customers utilizing the IBM AFP custom print language interface.

positions.title: Developer
positions.description: Contractor - Developer on the MPower Prepaid Meter Project and Developer in the Production Support Area

positions.title: Quality Assurance Analyst
positions.description: Managed testing activities for SRP’s ‘Smart Meter’ project. Developed and executed test cases for a web-based application, deriving test cases from the functional design document. Planned the sequence of test case execution over five logical days and documented failures in an Access database. Verified and gathered test data, validating results through GUI screens, SPUFI queries in DB2 tables, mainframe flat files, and reports. Collaborated with other QA Analysts, developers, and business experts to identify and resolve defects in SRP's Billing enhancements. Provided input for Test Case planning and documentation for subsequent User Acceptance Testing (UAT) activities.

positions.title: Programming Analyst
positions.description: Oversaw the support for downloading DB2 Policy Data to the AMS ORACLE Server. Provided data mapping, overall system design to facilitate downloads from the Policy and Claims systems, and DB2 Reporting System design, coding a total of 34 new programs and modifying 97. Performed data modeling of new tables and recommended changes to the DB2 version of vendor tables. Rendered QA support, debugged issues, and proposed solutions. Functioned as the lead programmer analyst on various projects within the Policy financial, reporting, and auditing subsystems. Participated in on-call production support for the nightly execution of the DB2 Policy System, resolving abends, DB2 issues, CICS problems, promotion issues, scheduling conflicts, JCL syntax errors, and COBOL coding errors, escalating to IT subject matter experts when necessary.

positions.title: Developer
positions.description:
Contractor -Two engagements at SCIF 
07/98 – 8/99 as QA Tester for Y2k
04/01 – 05/06 as a Developer

positions.title: QA Tester
positions.description: Contractor - QA Testing on Oracle platform

positions.title: Senior Consultant
positions.description: Managed Quality Assurance Testing for Oracle extracts to the Mainframe across three interfacing systems, and for changes to nightly batch updates from Mainframe to the Oracle database. Reviewed business requirements, project test data and plans, Mainframe CICS screens, the DB2 data model, client-server GUI screens, and the Oracle data model. Utilized SQL Navigator to query the Oracle database and created Unix shell scripts to extract data for shipment to the mainframe, updating DB2 tables. Collaborated closely with developers for hands-on application testing. Employed SPUFI to query and verify mainframe DB2 tables. Developed test scripts to validate CICS transactions, nightly batch updates to the Oracle database, and batch updates to DB2 tables from Oracle batch extracts. Spearheaded the End-to-End Validation effort, tracing data flow from mainframe to DB2, Oracle, updates via GUI screens, and back to the mainframe. This involved executing numerous mainframe jobs and Unix scripts.

positions.title: Senior Consultant
positions.description: Coordinated and led the Quality Assurance Testing for the Homeowners Insurance software package on Windows NT Workstations, Citrix Servers, and an Oracle database. Gathered and reviewed business requirements. Evaluated package software documentation and the Rate Filing with the Department of Insurance. Developed the Statement of Work. Prepared test cases. Established project schedules. Identified costs and resource requirements. Managed test case and script preparation, result tracking, and issue resolution. Collaborated with users on additional requirements and prepared project documentation. Liaised with users, actuaries, and the CSAA internal audit team.

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description: Contributed to the Y2K Project by inspecting code, aging files and DB2 database tables, developing test scripts and plans, correcting programs, testing and validating results, and updating relevant documentation. Systems supported included Claims, Policy/Premium, and Insurance Prospects, encompassing both batch and online components.

positions.title: Developer
positions.description: Contractor - Developer on the SUS Statement application

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description: Supported the Y2K Project by performing Year 2000 COBOL and Easytrieve program code updates for the SUS Statement application. This involved code inspection, file aging, and extensive coordination and testing of interfacing applications.

positions.title: Developer/Team Lead
positions.description:
Two engagements at CSAA
06/88 to 09/95  Employee -Developer/Team Lead on Homeowners Insurance Legacy system

8/99 – 8/00 Contractor - QA Testing new Homeowner Insurance package for Alaska

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description: Managed projects and tasks, defined requirements, and executed analysis, design, and implementation of improvements for legacy online and batch Homeowner and Automobile Insurance Systems. Successfully resolved issues pertaining to data transmission, storage, retrieval, and updates from external sources. Performed data modeling, collaborating with users to define data element rules and usage. Designed screens, reports, test plans, and detailed project and task management strategies. Served as Team Lead and Programmer/Analyst for the Emergency Road Service Application, a 24/7 client-server application operating across 12 sites and supporting over 200 workstations, utilizing data stored in indexed files on a file server and a remote DB2 database server. Functioned as an analyst to convert original COBOL programs to Micro Focus COBOL II, architecting a new system and developing GUI screens using Micro Focus GUI Screen Developer. Acted as Senior Programmer Analyst for CSAA’s Homeowners Policy application, responsible for enhancements and maintenance.
